THROW-FORWARD: Herfs Straat 22

By: Laura Byrne | Paid

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
A glimpse into the horror that ended one little girl's short life, and the system that failed to save her.

Summary:
A child, abused and neglected throughout her short life. A death that sparked outrage. This is the story of two-year-old Chevonne Rusch, brutally murdered by her mother’s boyfriend. But it is also the story of the system that failed Chevonne. Of authorities who ignored calls for help from family and friends. It’s the voice of so many vulnerable children who will never be heard. When a mother fails her own child, who is responsible? If someone had acted, would Chevonne still be alive?

Press Release:


In 2022, the tragic death of two-year-old Chevonne Rusch in Gauteng, sparked outrage. Her own mother and her mother’s boyfriend were taken into custody on charges relating to her killing. It’s a story that we’ve been tracking for over a year and from the onset, what became clear to us, was that Chevonne, was completely failed by those around, and the system that was meant to protect her. Here’s a sneak peak of this upcoming investigation.


Script:


VOICEOVER: A child neglected and abused throughout her short life.
UPSOUND: CHANELLE BRUMMER: Enige normale mense kan sien hierdie is nie speel of net ‘n valletjie of enige iets nie, hierdie kind word seergemaak.
VOICEOVER: A tragic and needless death.
UPSOUND: ANNARI DU PLESSIS: Four people in a house where a little girl died! I would have liked to […] see them explain to the court what happened in that house that night.
VOICEOVER: In an upcoming episode of Carte Blanche:
UPSOUND: KIRSTY-ANN HOSSEN: When we did come that night of the 11th, two trenches were dug…
VOICEOVER: This is the story of two-year-old Chevonne Rusch, brutally murdered by her mother’s boyfriend.
UPSOUND: CHANELLE BRUMMER: I couldn’t eat, I couldn’t sleep because I was thinking, how could adult people do this to her.
VOICEOVER: But it’s also the story of the system that failed Chevonne. Of authorities who ignored calls for help.
UPSOUND: ERIN BATES: Can I not open a case…?
UPSOUND: KIRSTY-ANN HOSSEN: They have authority to break through the gates and remove a child with immediate effect. They didn’t do it.
VOICEOVER: Of the voices of hundreds of vulnerable children that will never be heard.
UPSOUND: ANNARI DU PLESSIS: A little baby girl died and it’s like, it’s just another one.
UPSOUND: CHANELLE BRUMMER: As iemand uitgegaan het, as iemand iets gedoen het, […] dan was sy vandag hierso gewees.
